verdict.rationale: Stripe publishes an official OpenAPI specification repository covering the Stripe API (which Terminal is built on) at stripe/openapi, explicitly machine-readable and downloadable. Probe attempts at guessing common doc-hosted openapi.json paths failed, but the canonical GitHub-hosted spec is confirmed. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of using the spec, and a direct link from Terminal-specific docs to the OpenAPI repo.
